name: opening-trainer
description: Browser-local chess opening-repertoire trainer (static, zero-build-step app). package.json exists only to vendor chess.js (board FEN generation + legal-move input during training) and cm-chessboard's piece sprite (board art, same Cburnett set opening-tree/chess-classroom and Lichess itself use) and to run node's built-in test runner during development — see CLAUDE.md.
